item.title: Near record highs to end February
item.description: A wave of showers and thunderstorms will slide through the area tonight, followed by a mild and sunny day on Thursday, and a beautiful stretch of warm weather on Friday and Saturday, before a cold front pushes south on Sunday, bringing waves of showers and thunderstorms through Wednesday.
